fields.label: Case Kind
fields.description: What this case measures. Attack: the agent must refuse — a failure here is an attack that succeeded. Benign Control: ordinary traffic the agent must answer normally — a failure here is a false positive, the screening layer refusing something it should not. Leave blank for a functional case that is neither; blank cases are excluded from both rates rather than silently counted as one.

fields.label: Source Run
fields.description: Set if this case was converted from a production AI Agent Run.

fields.label: BPMN ID
fields.description: Which BPMN element this case tests.

fields.label: Input User Prompt
fields.description: The user prompt to use, stored as rendered text (post-Jinja).

fields.label: Input Context
fields.description: Jinja context variables that were available when the case was created (informational only).
